summary: BioHarvest Sciences, a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A, and CEO/CFO certifications for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The filing discloses no transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation; it is an ordinary periodic reporting package equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q. Financials show cash of $12.5M versus $23.0M at year-end 2025, revenues of $7.9M for the quarter, and an operating loss of $3.0M. Not a special situation; no risk-arb angle, with liquidity burn the only item to watch.
